name: creditfirst
description: CreditFirst - use the API credit that comes with your own Claude Max/Ultra plan first, with your paid key only as a fallback. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: creditfirst
plugins.description: Claude Code walks you through putting your Max/Ultra plan's monthly API credit on a Console organization, creating a key, handing the key over safely, and - if you have several accounts or a paid service key - deploying your own self-hosted hub that spends credit first and the paid key only when credit is short.
